name: Whisper Web
tagline: Whisper Web is a browser-based AI speech recognition tool powered by OpenAI's Whisper model
description: Whisper Web is a browser-based AI speech recognition tool powered by OpenAI's Whisper model. It converts audio and video files to accurate text transcriptions in over 100 languages — no downloads or installations required. Key Features - Real-time speech-to-text from microphone, file upload (MP3, WAV, M4A, MP4, MOV, WEBM), or media URLs - Speaker labels and timestamps for multi-person recordings - AI-powered summaries, analytics, and translation to 100+ languages - Export in TXT, SRT, VTT, JSON,
